symptom: The unmerged v166 non-scoring preflight accepted a free-standing EXCLUDE_AND_COUNT string as refundTreatment. Canonical Forward Vault 0.1 defines EXCLUDE_AND_COUNT only as unresolvedPolicy and has no frozen refund/void treatment field. A caller-supplied string could therefore be mistaken for independently frozen monetary semantics.
lesson: A frozen unresolved-evidence exclusion policy does not prove the ROI stake/return/refund/void contract. Do not name or accept unresolvedPolicy as refundTreatment; a digest or syntactically valid string cannot fill a missing prospective protocol field.
guardrail: At the Outcome Ledger to Forward Vault boundary require a canonical validated EvaluationProtocol object, reject free-standing policy strings or invented refundTreatment fields, and keep REFUNDED/VOID non-scoring with an explicit pending-frozen-monetary-policy status. Do not admit ROI until a separately versioned, prospectively frozen refund/void contract and independent evidence exist.
